description: Investigate a Python test suite that degraded from 45sec to 6min runtime. The project is located at /home/ga/workspace/api-testing-project with a Python virtual environment already activated. Run pytest with --durations flag to profile test execution times. Search the codebase for performance anti-patterns (time.sleep, real database calls, slow fixtures). Create a file named TEST_PERFORMANCE_ANALYSIS.md in the project root containing: (1) Top 5 slowest individual tests with execution times and file locations, (2) Top 3 slowest test files with aggregate times, (3) At least 3 specific performance issues with code locations (e.g., 'test_auth.py line 42: time.sleep(5)'), (4) At least 3 actionable recommendations (e.g., 'Replace sleep with mock time'). Read TASK_INSTRUCTIONS.md for detailed guidance. Use pytest profiling, VSCode search across files, and code inspection to identify bottlenecks.
